milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task — the player must navigate toward the ruined structure containing cracked stone bricks and face it. The target is set to the center of the structure at spawn-relative [10, 1, 10], which is where multiple cracked_stone_bricks are clustered. max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable approach distance, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking toward the structure (not just passing by with their back turned). This is preferred over position_inside_box per the design guidelines for find/observe tasks.
